config.notes: Adelaide University (merged Univ. of Adelaide + UniSA, teaching from 2026). Stored pages are all the new Adelaide University degree pages (/study/degrees/<slug>/, international view), on adelaide.edu.au and adelaideuni.edu.au (adelaideuni.edu.au now 302-redirects to adelaide.edu.au); no old degree-finder or UniSA pages are stored. Key-facts panel: "Start date ... Exact start date is outlined in the course timetable. February, July" (months printed; research degrees say any time of year - not read); "Indicative annual fees ... on a full-time annual basis. $52,500" (international annual; the variant "Where the duration of the program is less than one year, the total cost of the program is displayed" is a whole-program total and is deliberately NOT read; research "2027 Annual Fee ... differs across study areas" not read); "IELTS Overall 6.5" with bands per page; Duration "3 year(s) full-time"; Campus list; Mode "On campus". Academic calendar: https://adelaide.edu.au/students/manage-study/academic-calendar/ (2026 Semester 1 starts 23 Feb, Semester 2 starts 3 Aug; 2027 22 Feb / 2 Aug). No term_months used: course pages print months. 5 Oct 13:02 (international view check): the plain degree address already serves the international view (page title "Information for International students", "Future student - International student"); a test read of /study/degrees/2027/<slug>/int/?student=future (Bachelor of Computer Science (Honours), Bachelor of Arts; plain fetch, no Firecrawl) gave the same fee, intakes, IELTS and mode, so no page_view is set. The fee figure carries no printed year. Courses offered only to Australian students redirect to /study/degrees/2027/<slug>/dom/ ("Information for Domestic students"); their intakes, fee and delivery are excluded. 5 Oct 15:22 (exit awards and requirements): entry_requirement reads the key-facts Prerequisite (else Assumed knowledge, else the first Admission criteria line) for review. Exit awards: degree pages print only a generic stackable sentence ('you can exit after one year of study with a standalone Diploma or after two years with an Associate Degree'; masters 'after six months ... Graduate Certificate or after one year ... Graduate Diploma'), never the award title (e.g. 'Diploma in Building Studies') and never 'N years of full-time study', so no exit_awards pattern and the 'X Studies' exit awards cannot be linked to a parent from page text. No fee_total: courses under one year print a whole-program total (left without a fee); one-year diplomas (Building Studies, Legal Studies) show only the Australian-student fee panel.
